intent: The look of the Hypernormal site, as an app. State is exactly {mode, accent, radius, seq}. mode is "light" or "dark". accent is one of six names: "indigo", "green", "orange", "violet", "red", "teal". radius is "sharp", "soft", or "round". seq is an integer that goes up by one on every change; faces use it to report changes to the log app exactly once. A fresh mint starts at {mode: "light", accent: "indigo", radius: "soft", seq: 0}. Anyone may change the look; everyone watching sees the change at the same instant. No verb can express a broken look: every input is one of the values above, enforced by the schema. The values a face should render: radius sharp=0px, soft=8px, round=16px. Accent hex by mode: indigo light #3B5BDB dark #91A7FF; green light #2B8A3E dark #8CE99A; orange light #D9480F dark #FFC078; violet light #862E9C dark #E599F7; red light #C92A2A dark #FFA8A8; teal light #087F5B dark #63E6BE. Base colors light: bg #FFFFFF, fg #111111, muted #666666, line #E5E5E5, surface #F7F7F7. Base colors dark: bg #111111, fg #EDEDED, muted #999999, line #2A2A2A, surface #1B1B1B. A good face applies these as CSS custom properties and re-renders on every state message.

set_mode.description: Set the site to light or dark. Everyone sees it change.
set_mode.code: ctx.state.mode = ctx.input.mode; ctx.state.seq = (ctx.state.seq ?? 0) + 1; return { mode: ctx.state.mode, seq: ctx.state.seq };

set_accent.description: Set the site's accent color. One of: indigo, green, orange, violet, red, teal. Everyone sees it change.
set_accent.code: ctx.state.accent = ctx.input.accent; ctx.state.seq = (ctx.state.seq ?? 0) + 1; return { accent: ctx.state.accent, seq: ctx.state.seq };

set_radius.description: Set corner roundness: sharp (0px), soft (8px), or round (16px). Everyone sees it change.
set_radius.code: ctx.state.radius = ctx.input.radius; ctx.state.seq = (ctx.state.seq ?? 0) + 1; return { radius: ctx.state.radius, seq: ctx.state.seq };

reset.description: Restore the default look: light, indigo, soft.
reset.code: ctx.state.mode = "light"; ctx.state.accent = "indigo"; ctx.state.radius = "soft"; ctx.state.seq = (ctx.state.seq ?? 0) + 1; return { mode: "light", accent: "indigo", radius: "soft", seq: ctx.state.seq };
